item.title: So …. I’ve just seen in the @JewishChron that UCL has just axed its position of Antisemitism Officer. The only specialist Jewish students trusted is now … gone 🤷🏻‍♂️. The work will now be absorbed into the EDI department - run by a trustee of a charity with alleged Hamas links. Jewish students are already saying campus feels more hostile than ever. “Report, report, report” - but now to the same machine that’s failed them. Sound familiar? At Royal Holloway, every incident, every misconduct case, every complaint gets funnelled straight to the Wellbeing team. Same team. Same person at the top who evicted me from accommodation with under 48 hours notice for my keffiyeh comment. Staff who openly dislike my politics, me wearing the Union Jack, my views - and talked about me in politically degrading terms. When universities merge “antisemitism” into general DEI/Wellbeing bureaucracies staffed by people who wear the rainbow lanyards and side-eye common sense voices, who exactly are Jewish (or Zionist/conservative) students supposed to trust? The people who already see us as the problem? When our unis fail Jews and allies, who do we go to? The same officials who prioritise certain politics over protecting Jews on campus? This isn’t inclusion. UCL, Rhul, and every UK uni doing this: your Jewish students see you. Britain sees you. Fix it. #UCL #Antisemitism #CampusHate #RoyalHolloway #JewishStudents
